top_signals.title: Bloomberg Surveillance Live From Jackson Hole 8/28/2026
top_signals.summary: Tom Keene and Lisa Abramowicz host a special edition of "Bloomberg Surveillance" live from Jackson Hole. In his debut as Fed Chair at the annual gathering, Kevin Warsh warned inflation isn’t meaningfully slowing and said policymakers still have “work to do” unless they can be confident it is. Guests include Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, former Kansas City Fed President Esther George, the Bank of England’s Catherine Mann, Cornell University’s Eswar Prasad, Citi Wealth CIO Kate Moore, NewEdge Wealth CIO Cameron Dawson and PIMCO Global Economic Advisor Richard Clarida. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ex-head of resignation assistance firm gets suspended sentence
top_signals.summary: The Tokyo District Court found Shinji Tanimoto and his wife, Shiori, guilty of earning profit from referring customers to lawyers without a license to practice law.
